title: Project Codex ad-hoc memory sync view
description: Committed at ai[/°base]/memory/.codex-sync.json (and mirrored under this project's $CODEX_HOME resource dir). A derived, project-scoped view of registry.schema.json's notes: only the entries this project owns, without the project field (implicit). Written from the registry; never edit or merge by hand.

target.description: This memory file's path relative to this project's repo root, e.g. 'ai/°base/memory/<name>.md' or 'ai/memory/<name>.md'.
